expected_metrics.visual_hallucination_rate: = 0 on fixture set (confident answer under low-confidence/blocked frame)

description: Tests hallucination resistance as a policy behavior. Main sub-case: camera blocked or grounding confidence below threshold (0.49) — the stub grounding result carries low confidence; SpeakPolicy must route to an uncertainty/silence outcome with primary_reason_code=VISUAL_LOW_CONFIDENCE, not invent a confident answer. Positive sub-case (negative test path): high-confidence frame (0.92) — SpeakPolicy must produce full_response, proving resistance is not wired as blanket refusal.

fixture_conventions.deictic_p: All frames are deictic (>= 0.8) — 'what is this?'
fixture_conventions.scene_change_score: Scripted. Not the focus of this fixture.
fixture_conventions.grounding_result: 'unknown' for low-confidence/blocked frames; 'mug' for high-confidence frame.
fixture_conventions.grounding_confidence: < 0.5 for blocked/uncertain frames; >= 0.7 for confident frames.
fixture_conventions.sub_case: 'low_confidence' or 'high_confidence'. Consumers (task 12) partition by this field.
fixture_conventions.low_confidence_design: grounding_confidence=0.30 < threshold=0.5; SpeakPolicy must produce action_type in {silence} with primary_reason_code=VISUAL_LOW_CONFIDENCE. If it produces full_response the visual_hallucination_rate gate fails.
fixture_conventions.high_confidence_design: grounding_confidence=0.92 >= threshold; SpeakPolicy must produce full_response. If it produces silence/uncertainty here the test fails (blanket refusal is a bug).
fixture_conventions.frame_bytes_synthesis: raw_video frame blobs are minimal synthetic placeholders: b'\x89VID\x00' + 1 index byte. For the blocked-camera case the frame is all-zero payload bytes.
fixture_conventions.expected_events_markers: event_type strings are fixture-internal role labels.

signal_trace.notes: LOW-CONFIDENCE CASE: camera partially blocked; grounding stub returns confidence=0.30 < threshold=0.5
GATE FRAME (low confidence): confidence=0.30 < 0.5; must produce silence + VISUAL_LOW_CONFIDENCE; must NOT produce full_response
HIGH-CONFIDENCE CASE: camera clear; mug visible; grounding stub returns 0.92 >= threshold
GATE FRAME (high confidence): confidence=0.92 >= 0.5; must produce full_response. Positive discriminator: ensures resistance is not blanket refusal.

baseline_decisions.notes: confidence 0.30 < threshold 0.5; policy refuses to invent; visual_hallucination_rate gate
confidence 0.92 >= threshold; confident grounding; positive discriminator
